name: sim
description: Simulated rig: the reference simulated device of device protocol v1 runs in the rig runtime's own process, so a session needs no Teensy, NI-DAQ device or data drive. The calibration is v0.3's mapping. The safety envelope only guards the simulated valve. See docs/rig-file-v1.md.

ball.note: v0.3's mapping (device-v1.md section 10.4): forward = axis 1 (v0.3 field 8) x 0.0349 cm, left = axis 0 (field 7) x 0.0349 cm, yaw = axis 2 (field 9) x 0.05 rad; experiments/hallway04_experiment.py:84, :287-288
